subproblem.title: Two-sided Hausdorff-measure comparison on a bi-Lipschitz piece (supplied (NT))
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0 and m ∈ ℝ with m > 0. Let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz and let A ⊆ ℝⁿ be any set with m|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for all a, a' ∈ A. Then for every Z ⊆ A, in [0, ∞]: ofReal(m)ⁿ·λ(Z) ≤ Hⁿ(G(Z)) ≤ Lⁿ·λ(Z), where λ = volume on ℝⁿ and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ Z : Set (Euclid n), Z ⊆ A → ENNReal.ofReal m ^ n * volume Z ≤ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ∧ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * volume Z
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: the null-set transfer paragraph (NT) of the supplied proof ('the inverse K(E) → E is κ⁻¹-Lipschitz; Mathlib LipschitzOnWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le … and Hⁿ(K(Z)) ≤ Lip(K)ⁿLⁿ(Z)'), stated for one bi-Lipschitz piece; it is the quantitative form used by the siblings piece_sign, piece_rep and image_current. Notation: λ := volume on ℝⁿ; Hⁿ := μHE[n]; μH[d] is Mathlib's Hausdorff measure.
1. (Normalization.) By Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_def, on every metric space X, μHE[n] = c_n • μH[n] with the single constant c_n := addHaarScalarFactor (volume on EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) μH[n], which does not depend on X; so (μHE[n]) s = c_n·μH[n](s) for every s (Measure.smul_apply, ENNReal.smul_def). On ℝⁿ, μHE[n] = λ (EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume). If f is K-Lipschitz on a set s (K ∈ ℝ≥0), then μH[n](f(s)) ≤ K^(n:ℝ)·μH[n](s) (LipschitzOnWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le with d := n ≥ 0) and K^(n:ℝ) = Kⁿ (ENNReal.rpow_natCast); multiplying by c_n gives μHE[n](f(s)) ≤ Kⁿ·μHE[n](s).
2. (Upper bound.) G is L-Lipschitz on ℝⁿ (LipschitzWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le), so for every Z ⊆ ℝⁿ: Hⁿ(G(Z)) ≤ Lⁿ·μHE[n](Z) = Lⁿ·λ(Z).
3. (Injectivity on A.) If a, a' ∈ A and G(a) = G(a'), then m|a − a'| ≤ 0 with m > 0, hence a = a'. Let g := Function.invFunOn G A (ℝⁿ is nonempty). Then g(G(a)) = a for all a ∈ A (InjOn.leftInvOn_invFunOn).
4. (The inverse is Lipschitz.) g is m⁻¹-Lipschitz on G(A) (constant Real.toNNReal m⁻¹): for y = G(a), y' = G(a') with a, a' ∈ A, |g(y) − g(y')| = |a − a'| ≤ m⁻¹|G(a) − G(a')| = m⁻¹|y − y'| (LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul).
5. (Lower bound.) Let Z ⊆ A. By step 3, g(G(Z)) = Z. Step 1 for g on G(Z) ⊆ G(A) gives λ(Z) = μHE[n](Z) = μHE[n](g(G(Z))) ≤ (m⁻¹)ⁿ·Hⁿ(G(Z)). Multiply by ofReal(m)ⁿ and use ofReal(m)·ofReal(m⁻¹) = ofReal(m·m⁻¹) = 1 (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, m > 0): ofReal(m)ⁿ·λ(Z) ≤ Hⁿ(G(Z)). Steps 2 and 5 are the two inequalities. ∎
(A Lean proof of exactly this frozen type along steps 1–5 was compiled against the frozen contract during this decomposition.)

subproblem.statement: Assume (VO), (MR) and (IMC). (VO) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and test forms ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. (MR) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open, an IMRep R in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and every open W, M_W(T) = T.massOn W = R.measure W. (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and X ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) integer multiplicity. Then there is an IMRep R in U with R.Represents X, R.carrier ⊆ spt X (X.support) and R.measure(U) = M(X) (X.mass).
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support ∧ R.measure U = X.mass
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 1 (normalization) of the supplied proof, for an arbitrary open domain U. Hⁿ := μHE[n].
1. Let R₀ be an IMRep in U representing X, with carrier M₀, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ. Let Z := X.zeroRegion; Z is open (GeometricCurrentOn.isOpen_zeroRegion) and spt X = U ∖ Z by definition of X.support. Hence spt X is Borel (U and Z are open).
2. (M_Z(X) = 0.) Let ω be admissible for X.massOn Z, i.e. ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n Z: a test form in U with tsupport ω ⊆ Z and |ω(x)| ≤ 1. Since tsupport ω ⊆ Z is disjoint from spt X = U ∖ Z, (VO) gives X(ω) = 0, so ofReal(X ω) = 0. Thus X.massOn Z, the supremum of these values, is 0.
3. (Hⁿ(M₀ ∖ spt X) = 0.) By (MR) for X, R₀ and the open set Z: R₀.measure(Z) = X.massOn Z = 0. Since R₀.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M₀).withDensity θ and Z is Borel, R₀.measure(Z) = ∫⁻_{M₀∩Z} θ dHⁿ. As θ ≥ 1 on M₀ (θ is ℕ-valued and positive on M₀), Hⁿ(M₀ ∩ Z) ≤ ∫⁻_{M₀∩Z} θ dHⁿ = 0. Since M₀ ⊆ U, M₀ ∖ spt X = M₀ ∩ Z, so Hⁿ(M₀ ∖ spt X) = 0.
4. (Restriction.) (IMC)(b) with U, R₀ and the Borel set E := spt X gives a current A and an IMRep R in U with R.Represents A, R.carrier = M₀ ∩ spt X, R.mult = θ and R.orient = ξ.
5. (R represents X.) By step 3, M₀ ∩ spt X and M₀ are Hⁿ-a.e. equal, so Hⁿ⌞(M₀ ∩ spt X) = Hⁿ⌞M₀ (Measure.restrict_congr_set). Hence for every test form ω, R.action(ω) = ∫_{M₀∩spt X} θ ξ(ω) dHⁿ = ∫_{M₀} θ ξ(ω) dHⁿ = R₀.action(ω) = X(ω).
6. R.carrier = M₀ ∩ spt X ⊆ spt X.
7. (Mass.) (MR) for X, R and the open set U gives X.massOn U = R.measure U, and X.mass is X.massOn U by definition (GeometricCurrentOn.mass). Hence R.measure U = X.mass. ∎
proof_key_steps: spt X = U ∖ zeroRegion is Borel; every form admissible for M_{zeroRegion}(X) is killed by (VO), so M_{zeroRegion}(X) = 0.
(MR) on the open zero region and θ ≥ 1 give Hⁿ(M₀ ∖ spt X) = 0.
(IMC)(b) with E = spt X restricts the representation; equal restricted measures show it still represents X.
(MR) on U gives R.measure U = M(X).

Let p(y) :⟺ ∃ Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ y) Q, and Z := {u ∈ A : ¬p(H u)}, a λ-null set. subproblem.title: Parametric representation of a finite-mass IMRep by integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz pieces (supplied steps 2–3 and (AF))
subproblem.statement: Assume (B1), (GB) and (IMC). (B1) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.dpf_rectifiable_bilipschitz_pieces: every Borel countably n-rectifiable M ⊆ ℝ^P has Lipschitz G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, Borel A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ and m_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) with m_i|a − a'| ≤ |G_i(a) − G_i(a')| on A_i, G_i differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A_i, G_i(A_i) Borel ⊆ M, the G_i(A_i) pairwise disjoint and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_i G_i(A_i)) = 0. (GB) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.covectorEuclideanNorm_gram_bounds: for all P, n, (i) |α(v)| ≤ |α|·√det(⟨v_a, v_b⟩)_{a,b} for every n-covector α and v : Fin n → ℝ^P, and (ii) for orthonormal τ there is α with |α| ≤ 1 and α(τ) = 1. (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let R be an IMRep in U = ℝ^P (univ) of dimension n, with carrier M, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ, such that R.measure(ℝ^P) = ∫_M θ dHⁿ < ∞. Then there are, for i ∈ ℕ, maps G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, sets A_i ⊆ ℝⁿ, functions w_i : ℝⁿ → ℤ and c_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that: each G_i is Lipschitz; each A_i is Borel; each w_i and c_i is measurable; G_i is differentiable at every point of A_i; G_i(A_i) ⊆ M; w_i is Lebesgue integrable on A_i; for u ∈ A_i, c_i(u) ≥ 0 and |α(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1})| ≤ c_i(u)·|α| for every n-covector α (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α); Σ_i ∫⁻_{A_i} ofReal(|w_i|·c_i) dλ ≤ R.measure(ℝ^P); and for every continuous n-form η : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) with compact support, HasSum (i ↦ ∫_{A_i} w_i(u)·η(G_i(u))(DG_i(u)e_0, …, DG_i(u)e_{n−1}) du) (R.action(η)).

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 2 (B1) and 3 (B2′) of the supplied proof and the (AF) computation of its step 6, for an IMRep of finite total multiplicity. Conventions: Euclid P = ℝ^P; Hⁿ := μHE[n] (Euclidean-normalized Hausdorff measure); λ := volume on ℝⁿ = Euclid n (λ = μHE[n] there); e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 (a ∈ Fin n); for a map K, DK(u) := fderiv ℝ K u (the zero map where K is not differentiable) and v_K(u) := (DK(u)e_a)_a; J_K(u) := √det(⟨DK(u)e_a, DK(u)e_b⟩)_{a,b} (Real.sqrt of the Gram determinant); |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; for v : Fin n → ℝ^P, ev_v ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) is α ↦ α(v) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ v); an IMRep R has carrier M, multiplicity θ := R.mult and orientation ξ := R.orient.
1. (Pieces, B1.) M is Borel and countably n-rectifiable (R.measurableSet_carrier, R.rectifiable). (B1) applied to M gives G_i (L_i-Lipschitz), Borel A_i, m_i > 0 with m_i|a − a'| ≤ |G_i(a) − G_i(a')| on A_i, G_i differentiable with injective derivative on A_i, G_i(A_i) Borel ⊆ M, pairwise disjoint, and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_i G_i(A_i)) = 0. Write J_i := J_{G_i}, v_i(u) := v_{G_i}(u).
2. (Signs.) For each i the sibling piece_sign (with (IMC), U := ℝ^P open, R, G_i, A_i, L_i, m_i; G_i(A_i) ⊆ M) gives a measurable s_i : ℝⁿ → ℤ, s_i ∈ {1, −1}, with J_i(u)·ξ(G_i u)(α) = s_i(u)·α(v_i(u)) for every α, for λ-a.e. u ∈ A_i.
3. (Definitions.) w_i(u) := (θ(G_i u) : ℤ)·s_i(u) and c_i(u) := J_i(u). w_i is measurable (θ measurable, G_i continuous, s_i measurable); c_i is measurable by the sibling area_lintegral, part (i), and c_i ≥ 0. Moreover |w_i(u)| = θ(G_i u).
4. (Gram bound.) For u ∈ A_i and every α, (GB)(i) gives |α(v_i(u))| ≤ |α|·√det Gram(v_i(u)) = c_i(u)·|α|.
5. (Measure comparison.) By the sibling bilip_measure (G_i, A_i, L_i, m_i), ofReal(m_i)ⁿλ(Z) ≤ Hⁿ(G_i(Z)) for Z ⊆ A_i. For Borel B ⊆ ℝ^P take Z := A_i ∩ G_i⁻¹(B): ofReal(m_i)ⁿ·(λ⌞A_i)(G_i⁻¹B) ≤ Hⁿ(G_i(Z)) ≤ Hⁿ(G_i(A_i) ∩ B) = (Hⁿ⌞G_i(A_i))(B). So ofReal(m_i)ⁿ • Measure.map G_i (λ⌞A_i) ≤ Hⁿ⌞G_i(A_i), and for every Borel f ≥ 0, ofReal(m_i)ⁿ∫⁻_{A_i} f(G_i u) du ≤ ∫⁻_{G_i(A_i)} f dHⁿ (lintegral_map).
6. (Integrability of w_i.) With f := θ: ∫⁻_{A_i} |w_i| dλ = ∫⁻_{A_i} θ(G_i u) du ≤ ofReal(m_i)⁻ⁿ∫⁻_{G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ ≤ ofReal(m_i)⁻ⁿ∫⁻_M θ dHⁿ = ofReal(m_i)⁻ⁿR.measure(ℝ^P) < ∞. As w_i is measurable, it is integrable on A_i.
7. (Mass sum.) For each i the sibling area_lintegral, part (ii) (f := G_i, s := A_i: Borel, G_i differentiable with injective derivative on A_i and injective on A_i; g := θ), gives ∫⁻_{A_i} ofReal(|w_i|c_i) dλ = ∫⁻_{A_i} ofReal(J_i(u))·θ(G_i u) du = ∫⁻_{G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ. The G_i(A_i) are Borel, pairwise disjoint and contained in M, so Σ_i ∫⁻_{G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ = ∫⁻_{⋃_i G_i(A_i)} θ dHⁿ (lintegral_iUnion) ≤ ∫⁻_M θ dHⁿ = R.measure(ℝ^P) (R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ).
8. (Representation.) Let η be a continuous n-form with compact support; C := sup_y |η(y)| < ∞ (covectorEuclideanNorm is continuous, being the square root of a finite sum of squares of evaluations). Put f(x) := θ(x)·ξ(x)(η(x)).
(a) f is integrable on M for Hⁿ: it is a.e. strongly measurable (θ measurable, ξ a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M, η continuous, the pairing (ζ, α) ↦ ζ(α) continuous bilinear), and by (IMC)(d) |f(x)| ≤ θ(x)|η(x)| ≤ C·θ(x) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, while ∫_M θ dHⁿ < ∞.
(b) hasSum_integral_iUnion for the disjoint Borel sets G_i(A_i) (f integrable on their union ⊆ M) gives HasSum (i ↦ ∫_{G_i(A_i)} f dHⁿ) (∫_{⋃_i G_i(A_i)} f dHⁿ). Since ⋃_i G_i(A_i) ⊆ M and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_i G_i(A_i)) = 0, these sets are Hⁿ-a.e. equal, so the sum is ∫_M f dHⁿ = R.action(η).
(c) For each i the sibling area_integral (G := G_i, F := A_i, h := f) gives ∫_{G_i(A_i)} f dHⁿ = ∫_{A_i} J_i(u)f(G_i u) du = ∫_{A_i} θ(G_i u)·[J_i(u)ξ(G_i u)(η(G_i u))] du. By step 2 with α := η(G_i u), for λ-a.e. u ∈ A_i the bracket equals s_i(u)·η(G_i u)(v_i(u)). Hence (setIntegral_congr_ae) ∫_{G_i(A_i)} f dHⁿ = ∫_{A_i} w_i(u)·η(G_i u)(v_i(u)) du.
(d) (b) and (c) give HasSum (i ↦ ∫_{A_i} w_i(u)η(G_i u)(DG_i(u)e) du) (R.action(η)).
9. The remaining clauses (G_i Lipschitz, A_i Borel, G_i differentiable on A_i, G_i(A_i) ⊆ M) are part of step 1. ∎
